content:
Use separate identity reference images for each character (e.g., @Image 1 HERO, @Image 2 OPPONENT) and explicitly instruct “preserve face/wardrobe,” “all views are one man,” “output one HERO/one OPPONENT,” and “never swap identity or wardrobe” to prevent identity drift/swaps.

Define the scene with hard constraints (photorealistic, dark packed arena, white canvas/ropes/overhead light, crowd silhouettes) and explicitly limit the cast (“exactly two boxers only”) to avoid extra people/duplicates.

Storyboard the video by timestamped beats (e.g., 0–4s evasion, 4–7s hit, 7–10s counter, 10–16s combo, 16–20s KO) to control pacing and ensure the model hits specific actions in order.

Specify camera language and continuity rules (e.g., “lateral medium tracking,” “one continuous low side-medium take,” “only a 0.4s close-up,” “no orbit/drone/direction reversal”) to stabilize framing and prevent unwanted camera moves.

Control slow motion precisely by allowing it only in a defined segment (“enter the only slow motion” at the counter) and banning it elsewhere (“no slow motion” earlier; “constant slow motion” excluded).

Add physics/impact constraints (“reactions begin at contact,” “misses cause no facial deformation,” “show cheek compression/sweat spray,” “no pre-impact shake; camera shakes only after contact”) to improve realism and reduce fake hits.

Include explicit negative constraints/locks (no referee, no extra limbs/gloves, no teleportation, no gore, no text/logos/watermarks, no duplicates) to prevent common generation artifacts.

[Thread 1] SEEDANCE 2.5 - LIVE-ACTION BOXING REVERSAL, 20s

ASSETS

@Image 1 = HERO, Japanese boxer. Preserve his face, black hair, lean body, white trunks, burgundy gloves and white shoes. All views are one man: output one HERO. Neutral portrait defines identity; smile defines only teeth. Ignore studio background.

@Image 2 = OPPONENT, taller European boxer. Preserve his face, blue eyes, light-brown hair, eyebrow mark, long-limbed body, navy trunks/gloves and black-blue shoes. All views are one man: output one OPPONENT. Neutral portrait defines identity; smile defines only teeth. Ignore studio background. Never swap identity or wardrobe.

SCENE

Photorealistic championship boxing in a dark packed arena: white canvas, ropes, overhead light, crowd silhouettes. Two boxers only. OPPONENT starts screen-left advancing right; HERO starts screen-right near ropes. Keep direction until HERO attacks. HERO has low left glove, right at jaw, soft knees. OPPONENT has tall stance and long spear-like jab.

0-4s EVASION

Start with a left jab already near HERO's face. Lateral medium tracking keeps glove and face visible. OPPONENT advances with five fast left jabs from the same glove. HERO does not counter: tiny chin pull, outside slip, inside dip, half-step back, lean-back pivot. Each misses by centimeters, moving only hair and sweat. OPPONENT observes HERO's repeated backward reaction.

End: OPPONENT feints another jab and steps deeper.

4-7s HERO IS HIT

OPPONENT shows a false left jab. HERO leans back as expected. OPPONENT follows with a long right cross landing on HERO's left cheek. Show contact, cheek compression, sweat spray, head turn and HERO falling into ropes. Hard dry impact; music becomes muffled crowd and ringing. HERO stays standing but is hurt. No slow motion.

End: OPPONENT rushes in, loading another right.

7-10s CLOSE-UP AND COUNTER

Hard cut for only 0.4s to HERO's three-quarter close-up matching @Image 1. Sweat crosses his struck cheek. Eyes briefly unfocused, then snap onto OPPONENT's advancing right shoulder. Chin lowers; one nasal breath. No smile/dialogue. Navy glove blurred at frame edge.

Immediately cut to a low two-shot before contact. Enter the only slow motion. OPPONENT drives a right cross. HERO bends knees, slips centimeters outside it and pivots on his left foot, simultaneously landing a compact left hook on OPPONENT's exposed right temple. Show forward weight, slip, hip/shoulder turn and exact contact.

Return to real time. OPPONENT stays up, but head turns, eyes lose focus, torso tilts and feet cross. Right glove rises late to temple; left arm opens for balance.

10-16s GUARD BREAKDOWN

One continuous low side-medium take keeps feet and gloves visible.

HERO attacks the broken balance:

1. Right straight to solar plexus folds OPPONENT.

2. Left uppercut lifts chin and guard.

3. Right body hook pulls his left elbow down.

4. Left hook hits his right glove and turns head right.

Each hit creates the next opening. Punches use foot pressure, hip/shoulder rotation and recovery. OPPONENT tries to block, but crossed feet keep his guard late; he never freezes.

End: head turned right, left glove/elbow low, left jaw exposed.

16-20s FINAL RIGHT HOOK

Brief pause on HERO's eyes, rear-foot pressure and open jaw. Sound drops for a fraction.

Without winding up, HERO drives from rear foot and throws a compact right hook through the gap between OPPONENT's low left glove and shoulder. Show it more clearly than earlier blows. Exact left-jaw contact, 1-2 impact frames. Camera shakes only after contact.

Reaction: jaw compresses, head rotates, sweat and mouthguard arc away, legs cross, both knees fall. No instant ragdoll. HERO returns to guard and does not pursue.

Final frame: OPPONENT down near ropes; HERO standing balanced.

PHYSICS/CAMERA/AUDIO

Punches follow foot pressure, weight, hip, shoulder, glove path, contact/miss, recovery. Dodges use knees, waist and feet. Misses cause no facial deformation; reactions begin at contact.

Readable ringside tracking and medium shots; only the 0.4s close-up. Natural blur on gloves only. No orbit, drone, direction reversal or pre-impact shake.

Restrained percussion initially. HERO's hit brings muffled crowd/ringing. Brief audio vacuum before temple counter, then crowd release. Distinct body/guard sounds. Final hook: heavy impact, crowd/music peak, mouthguard landing. No dialogue/subtitles.

LOCKS

Exactly two boxers. Five jabs miss; first long right hits HERO. HERO first attacks with temple counter. Slow motion only there. Temple hit breaks balance but does not knock down. Final right hook causes the only knockdown.

Exclude duplicates, referee, identity/costume swaps, extra limbs/gloves, fused bodies, teleportation, false hits, synchronized motion, constant slow motion, excessive blur, blood, gore, broken teeth, weapons, fantasy effects, text, logos, watermarks.

[Thread 1] SEEDANCE 2.5 - LIVE-ACTION BOXING REVERSAL, 20s

ASSETS

@Image 1 = HERO, boxeador japonés. Conserva su rostro, cabello negro, cuerpo delgado, trunks blancos, guantes burdeos y zapatos blancos. Todas las vistas son de un solo hombre: output one HERO. El retrato neutro define la identidad; la sonrisa define solo los dientes. Ignora el fondo de estudio.

@Image 2 = OPPONENT, boxeador europeo más alto. Conserva su rostro, ojos azules, cabello castaño claro, marca en la ceja, cuerpo de extremidades largas, trunks/guantes azul marino y zapatos negro-azules. Todas las vistas son de un solo hombre: output one OPPONENT. El retrato neutro define la identidad; la sonrisa define solo los dientes. Ignora el fondo de estudio. Never swap identity or wardrobe.

SCENE

Boxeo de campeonato photorealistic en una dark packed arena: white canvas, ropes, overhead light, crowd silhouettes. Two boxers only. OPPONENT starts screen-left advancing right; HERO starts screen-right near ropes. Mantén la dirección hasta que HERO ataque. HERO tiene el guante izquierdo bajo, el derecho a la mandíbula y las rodillas flexionadas. OPPONENT tiene una postura alta y un jab largo, tipo lanza.

0-4s EVASION

Empieza con un jab izquierdo ya cerca del rostro de HERO. Lateral medium tracking mantiene visibles el guante y la cara. OPPONENT avanza con cinco jabs izquierdos rápidos desde el mismo guante. HERO no contraataca: pequeño retraimiento de mentón, slip exterior, dip interior, medio paso atrás, pivot con lean-back. Cada uno falla por centímetros, moviendo solo cabello y sudor. OPPONENT observa la reacción repetida de retroceso de HERO.

End: OPPONENT finta otro jab y entra más profundo.

4-7s HERO IS HIT

OPPONENT muestra un falso jab izquierdo. HERO se inclina hacia atrás como se espera. OPPONENT sigue con un long right cross que impacta en la mejilla izquierda de HERO. Muestra el contacto, la compresión de la mejilla, la salpicadura de sudor, el giro de la cabeza y a HERO cayendo contra las cuerdas. Impacto seco y fuerte; la música se vuelve un murmullo amortiguado de la multitud y un zumbido. HERO sigue de pie, pero está lastimado. No slow motion.

End: OPPONENT se lanza hacia dentro, cargando otro derechazo.

7-10s CLOSE-UP AND COUNTER

Corte duro durante solo 0.4s a un close-up en tres cuartos de HERO que coincida con @Image 1. El sudor cruza su mejilla golpeada. Los ojos quedan brevemente desenfocados y luego se fijan en el hombro derecho avanzado de OPPONENT. La barbilla baja; una sola inhalación nasal. Sin sonrisa ni diálogo. Guante azul marino desenfocado en el borde del encuadre.

Corta inmediatamente a un two-shot bajo antes del contacto. Enter the only slow motion. OPPONENT lanza un right cross. HERO flexiona las rodillas, lo esquiva por centímetros por fuera y pivota sobre el pie izquierdo, al mismo tiempo conectando un left hook compacto en la sien derecha expuesta de OPPONENT. Muestra el peso hacia delante, el slip, la rotación de cadera/hombro y el contacto exacto.

Vuelve al tiempo real. OPPONENT sigue en pie, pero la cabeza gira, la mirada pierde foco, el torso se inclina y los pies se cruzan. El guante derecho sube tarde a la sien; el brazo izquierdo se abre para mantener el equilibrio.

10-16s GUARD BREAKDOWN

Un único plano continuo low side-medium mantiene visibles los pies y los guantes.

HERO ataca el equilibrio roto:

1. Right straight al plexo solar dobla a OPPONENT.

2. Left uppercut eleva la barbilla y la guardia.

3. Right body hook baja el codo izquierdo.

4. Left hook golpea su guante derecho y gira la cabeza hacia la derecha.

Cada golpe crea la siguiente apertura. Los puñetazos usan presión del pie, rotación de cadera/hombro y recuperación. OPPONENT intenta bloquear, pero los pies cruzados hacen que su guardia llegue tarde; nunca se congela.

End: cabeza girada a la derecha, guante/codo izquierdo bajos, mandíbula izquierda expuesta.

16-20s FINAL RIGHT HOOK

Breve pausa en los ojos de HERO, la presión del pie trasero y la mandíbula abierta. El sonido cae durante una fracción.

Sin cargar el golpe, HERO impulsa desde el pie trasero y lanza un compact right hook a través del hueco entre el guante izquierdo bajo de OPPONENT y su hombro. Muéstralo con más claridad que los golpes anteriores. Contacto exacto en la mandíbula izquierda, 1-2 impact frames. Camera shakes only after contact.

Reaction: la mandíbula se comprime, la cabeza rota, el sudor y el protector bucal salen en arco, las piernas se cruzan, ambas rodillas caen. No instant ragdoll. HERO vuelve a la guardia y no persigue.

Final frame: OPPONENT caído cerca de las cuerdas; HERO de pie y equilibrado.

PHYSICS/CAMERA/AUDIO

Los golpes siguen presión del pie, peso, cadera, hombro, trayectoria del guante, contacto/fallo y recuperación. Las esquivas usan rodillas, cintura y pies. Los fallos no causan deformación facial; las reacciones comienzan en el contacto.

Tracking de ringside legible y planos medios; solo el close-up de 0.4s. Desenfoque natural solo en los guantes. No orbit, drone, direction reversal ni pre-impact shake.

Percusión contenida al inicio. El golpe de HERO trae murmullo amortiguado de la multitud/zumbido. Breve vacío de audio antes del counter a la sien, luego liberación de la multitud. Sonidos corporales/de guardia bien definidos. Final hook: impacto pesado, pico de multitud/música, caída del mouthguard. Sin diálogo/subtítulos.

LOCKS

Exactly two boxers. Five jabs miss; first long right hits HERO. HERO first attacks with temple counter. Slow motion only there. Temple hit breaks balance but does not knock down. Final right hook causes the only knockdown.

Exclude duplicates, referee, identity/costume swaps, extra limbs/gloves, fused bodies, teleportation, false hits, synchronized motion, constant slow motion, excessive blur, blood, gore, broken teeth, weapons, fantasy effects, text, logos, watermarks.

[Thread 1] SEEDANCE 2.5 - LIVE-ACTION BOXING REVERSAL, 20s

ASSETS

@Image 1 = HERO, boxeur japonais. Préservez son visage, ses cheveux noirs, sa silhouette mince, son short blanc, ses gants bordeaux et ses chaussures blanches. Toutes les vues correspondent à un seul homme : output one HERO. Le portrait neutre définit l’identité ; le sourire ne définit que les dents. Ignorez l’arrière-plan du studio.

@Image 2 = OPPONENT, boxeur européen plus grand. Préservez son visage, ses yeux bleus, ses cheveux châtain clair, sa marque au sourcil, son corps aux longs segments, son short/gants bleu marine et ses chaussures noir-bleu. Toutes les vues correspondent à un seul homme : output one OPPONENT. Le portrait neutre définit l’identité ; le sourire ne définit que les dents. Ignorez l’arrière-plan du studio. Never swap identity or wardrobe.

SCENE

Boxe de championnat photoréaliste dans une arène sombre et bondée : toile blanche, cordes, lumière zénithale, silhouettes de foule. Deux boxeurs seulement. OPPONENT commence à l’écran à gauche en avançant vers la droite ; HERO commence à l’écran à droite près des cordes. Conservez cette direction jusqu’à l’attaque de HERO. HERO garde le gant gauche bas, le droit au niveau de la mâchoire, les genoux souples. OPPONENT adopte une garde haute et un jab long, en lance.

0-4s EVASION

Commencez avec un jab gauche déjà proche du visage de HERO. Le lateral medium tracking maintient le gant et le visage visibles. OPPONENT avance avec cinq jabs gauches rapides depuis le même gant. HERO ne contre pas : léger retrait du menton, slip extérieur, dip intérieur, demi-pas en arrière, pivot en lean-back. Chaque coup manque de quelques centimètres, ne déplaçant que quelques cheveux et un peu de sueur. OPPONENT observe la réaction répétée de recul de HERO.

Fin : OPPONENT feinte un autre jab et s’engage davantage.

4-7s HERO IS HIT

OPPONENT simule un faux jab gauche. HERO se penche en arrière comme prévu. OPPONENT enchaîne avec un long cross du droit qui atteint la joue gauche de HERO. Montrez le contact, la compression de la joue, l’éclaboussure de sueur, la rotation de la tête et HERO qui retombe contre les cordes. Impact sec et brutal ; la musique devient un bourdonnement étouffé de foule et un sifflement. HERO reste debout mais est sonné. No slow motion.

Fin : OPPONENT se rue vers l’avant, en chargeant un autre droit.

7-10s CLOSE-UP AND COUNTER

Cut brutal pour seulement 0,4 s vers un gros plan en trois-quarts de HERO correspondant à @Image 1. La sueur traverse sa joue frappée. Les yeux sont brièvement flous, puis se fixent sur l’épaule droite avancée de OPPONENT. Le menton s’abaisse ; une seule inspiration nasale. Pas de sourire ni de dialogue. Le gant bleu marine est flou au bord du cadre.

Cut immédiat vers un plan à deux en contre-plongée avant le contact. Enter the only slow motion. OPPONENT lance un cross du droit. HERO plie les genoux, l’esquive de quelques centimètres vers l’extérieur et pivote sur son pied gauche, tout en plaçant simultanément un crochet gauche compact sur la tempe droite exposée de OPPONENT. Montrez l’appui vers l’avant, le slip, la rotation des hanches/épaules et le contact exact.

Retour au temps réel. OPPONENT reste debout, mais sa tête tourne, son regard se trouble, son buste bascule et ses pieds se croisent. Le gant droit monte tard vers la tempe ; le bras gauche s’ouvre pour garder l’équilibre.

10-16s GUARD BREAKDOWN

Un plan latéral bas et moyen continu garde les pieds et les gants visibles.

HERO attaque l’équilibre rompu :

1. Direct du droit au plexus solaire qui plie OPPONENT.

2. Uppercut gauche qui soulève le menton et la garde.

3. Crochet au corps du droit qui abaisse le coude gauche.

4. Crochet gauche qui frappe le gant droit de OPPONENT et tourne sa tête vers la droite.

Chaque coup crée l’ouverture suivante. Les coups utilisent la pression des appuis, la rotation hanches/épaules et le retour. OPPONENT tente de bloquer, mais ses pieds croisés rendent sa garde trop lente ; il ne se fige jamais.

Fin : tête tournée à droite, gant/coude gauche bas, mâchoire gauche exposée.

16-20s FINAL RIGHT HOOK

Brève pause sur les yeux de HERO, la pression du pied arrière et la mâchoire ouverte. Le son chute pendant une fraction de seconde.

Sans armé, HERO pousse depuis le pied arrière et lance un crochet droit compact à travers l’espace entre le gant gauche bas de OPPONENT et son épaule. Montrez-le plus clairement que les coups précédents. Contact exact sur la mâchoire gauche, 1–2 frames d’impact. Camera shakes only after contact.

Réaction : la mâchoire se comprime, la tête pivote, la sueur et le protège-dents s’envolent en arc, les jambes se croisent, les deux genoux cèdent. Pas de ragdoll instantané. HERO revient en garde et ne poursuit pas.

Dernier plan : OPPONENT au sol près des cordes ; HERO debout, équilibré.

PHYSICS/CAMERA/AUDIO

Les coups suivent la pression des appuis, le transfert de poids, les hanches, les épaules, la trajectoire du gant, le contact/l’échec, puis la récupération. Les esquives utilisent les genoux, la taille et les pieds. Les ratés ne provoquent aucune déformation du visage ; les réactions commencent au contact.

Tracking lisible au bord du ring et plans moyens ; seul le gros plan de 0,4 s. Flou naturel uniquement sur les gants. No orbit, drone, direction reversal or pre-impact shake.

Percussion retenue au départ. Le coup de HERO apporte un bourdonnement étouffé de foule et un sifflement. Brève vacuité sonore avant le contre à la tempe, puis relâchement de la foule. Sons distincts du corps et de la garde. Crochet final : impact lourd, pic de foule/musique, chute du protège-dents. Pas de dialogue ni de sous-titres.

LOCKS

Exactly two boxers. Five jabs miss; first long right hits HERO. HERO first attacks with temple counter. Slow motion only there. Temple hit breaks balance but does not knock down. Final right hook causes the only knockdown.

Exclude duplicates, referee, identity/costume swaps, extra limbs/gloves, fused bodies, teleportation, false hits, synchronized motion, constant slow motion, excessive blur, blood, gore, broken teeth, weapons, fantasy effects, text, logos, watermarks.

각 캐릭터마다 별도의 정체성 참조 이미지를 사용하고(예: @Image 1 HERO, @Image 2 OPPONENT), “preserve face/wardrobe”, “all views are one man”, “output one HERO/one OPPONENT”, “never swap identity or wardrobe”를 명시적으로 지시해 정체성 드리프트/스왑을 방지한다.

장면은 하드 제약으로 정의한다(photorealistic, dark packed arena, white canvas/ropes/overhead light, crowd silhouettes). 또한 출연진을 명확히 제한한다(“exactly two boxers only”) — 추가 인물/중복을 피하기 위해서다.

ASSETS

@Image 1 = HERO, Japanese boxer. Preserve his face, black hair, lean body, white trunks, burgundy gloves and white shoes. All views are one man: output one HERO. Neutral portrait defines identity; smile defines only teeth. Ignore studio background.

@Image 2 = OPPONENT, taller European boxer. Preserve his face, blue eyes, light-brown hair, eyebrow mark, long-limbed body, navy trunks/gloves and black-blue shoes. All views are one man: output one OPPONENT. Neutral portrait defines identity; smile defines only teeth. Ignore studio background. Never swap identity or wardrobe.

SCENE

Photorealistic championship boxing in a dark packed arena: white canvas, ropes, overhead light, crowd silhouettes. Two boxers only. OPPONENT starts screen-left advancing right; HERO starts screen-right near ropes. Keep direction until HERO attacks. HERO has low left glove, right at jaw, soft knees. OPPONENT has tall stance and long spear-like jab.

0-4s EVASION

Start with a left jab already near HERO's face. Lateral medium tracking keeps glove and face visible. OPPONENT advances with five fast left jabs from the same glove. HERO does not counter: tiny chin pull, outside slip, inside dip, half-step back, lean-back pivot. Each misses by centimeters, moving only hair and sweat. OPPONENT observes HERO's repeated backward reaction.

End: OPPONENT feints another jab and steps deeper.

4-7s HERO IS HIT

OPPONENT shows a false left jab. HERO leans back as expected. OPPONENT follows with a long right cross landing on HERO's left cheek. Show contact, cheek compression, sweat spray, head turn and HERO falling into ropes. Hard dry impact; music becomes muffled crowd and ringing. HERO stays standing but is hurt. No slow motion.

End: OPPONENT rushes in, loading another right.

7-10s CLOSE-UP AND COUNTER

Hard cut for only 0.4s to HERO's three-quarter close-up matching @Image 1. Sweat crosses his struck cheek. Eyes briefly unfocused, then snap onto OPPONENT's advancing right shoulder. Chin lowers; one nasal breath. No smile/dialogue. Navy glove blurred at frame edge.

Immediately cut to a low two-shot before contact. Enter the only slow motion. OPPONENT drives a right cross. HERO bends knees, slips centimeters outside it and pivots on his left foot, simultaneously landing a compact left hook on OPPONENT's exposed right temple. Show forward weight, slip, hip/shoulder turn and exact contact.

Return to real time. OPPONENT stays up, but head turns, eyes lose focus, torso tilts and feet cross. Right glove rises late to temple; left arm opens for balance.

10-16s GUARD BREAKDOWN

One continuous low side-medium take keeps feet and gloves visible.

HERO attacks the broken balance:

1. Right straight to solar plexus folds OPPONENT.

2. Left uppercut lifts chin and guard.

3. Right body hook pulls his left elbow down.

4. Left hook hits his right glove and turns head right.

Each hit creates the next opening. Punches use foot pressure, hip/shoulder rotation and recovery. OPPONENT tries to block, but crossed feet keep his guard late; he never freezes.

End: head turned right, left glove/elbow low, left jaw exposed.

16-20s FINAL RIGHT HOOK

Brief pause on HERO's eyes, rear-foot pressure and open jaw. Sound drops for a fraction.

Without winding up, HERO drives from rear foot and throws a compact right hook through the gap between OPPONENT's low left glove and shoulder. Show it more clearly than earlier blows. Exact left-jaw contact, 1-2 impact frames. Camera shakes only after contact.

Reaction: jaw compresses, head rotates, sweat and mouthguard arc away, legs cross, both knees fall. No instant ragdoll. HERO returns to guard and does not pursue.

Final frame: OPPONENT down near ropes; HERO standing balanced.

PHYSICS/CAMERA/AUDIO

Punches follow foot pressure, weight, hip, shoulder, glove path, contact/miss, recovery. Dodges use knees, waist and feet. Misses cause no facial deformation; reactions begin at contact.

Readable ringside tracking and medium shots; only the 0.4s close-up. Natural blur on gloves only. No orbit, drone, direction reversal or pre-impact shake.

Restrained percussion initially. HERO's hit brings muffled crowd/ringing. Brief audio vacuum before temple counter, then crowd release. Distinct body/guard sounds. Final hook: heavy impact, crowd/music peak, mouthguard landing. No dialogue/subtitles.

LOCKS

Exactly two boxers. Five jabs miss; first long right hits HERO. HERO first attacks with temple counter. Slow motion only there. Temple hit breaks balance but does not knock down. Final right hook causes the only knockdown.
